firm_data.firm_description: Weidenbaum & Harari, a Manhattan-based law firm, focuses on serving the legal needs of the real estate and construction industries. They built their business through referrals from prior clients, leading NYC-area real estate brokers, building owners, contractors, and construction suppliers who appreciate their legal intelligence, hands-on approach, and creative solutions.
notable_facts: The firm was founded by Barry Weidenbaum and Jack Harari.
They have successfully closed thousands of real estate transactions.
The firm emphasizes teamwork, trust, and honesty.

email.subject: AI for Weidenbaum & Harari, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Quinn,

Your firm has closed thousands of real estate transactions by earning trust through hands-on work and creative solutions. That track record comes from precision and client relationships, not process bloat.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in Manhattan to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
